name: 92101 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92101 (San Diego) has 446 nonprofit organizations. 212 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 181 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92101 (San Diego) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92101 (San Diego) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 121 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
